## vpick-video-creator 1.0.2 Changelog

- Added a new "Security & Data Handling" section to the documentation.
- Clarified authentication: all access is via MCP link with embedded token; no extra API keys needed.
- Explained data flow, storage, and billing (charges go to VPick credits; prompts/media are routed through VPick and sent to third-party providers).
- Emphasized no local credentials or environment variables are required.
- Updated prerequisite steps to reflect the streamlined security and connection process.

VPick Video Creator v1.0.1

- Added core documentation (SKILL.md) covering supported video, image, and audio models, workflow, and usage instructions.
- Details prerequisites, MCP setup, canvas/project management, and end-to-end AI video production pipeline.
- Explains MultiShot and single-shot video generation, plus steps for voiceover, music, lip sync, and vocal separation.
- Lists model costs, limitations, and best-use scenarios for each tool integrated into the workflow.
- Includes clear code examples for nodes, connections, and generator commands.
